text: やさしそうな　おねえさん　たちに　ゆだん　しない　ほうが　いいわよ！

structure.jp: やさしそうな　おねえさん　たちに
ゆだん　しない　ほうが　いいわよ！
structure.en: you'd better not let your guard down!

patterns.name: 〜ほうがいい
patterns.span: しない　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: ほうがいい after a verb gives advice: 'it is better to'. After a 'not' verb it means 'better not to'. しない　ほうが　いい = 'you'd better not do it'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks)
patterns.explanation: そう added to a describing word means 'looks that way'. やさしそうな = 'kind-looking'.
